declaration:
VAR_GLOBAL
    (* ================= Commands (HMI / online write) ================= *)
    xEnable     : BOOL;              (* power on / off the servo axis *)
    xReset      : BOOL;              (* reset axis error *)
    xStop       : BOOL;              (* stop and lock the axis *)
    xJogFwd     : BOOL;              (* jog forward (level) *)
    xJogRev     : BOOL;              (* jog reverse (level) *)
    xMoveRel    : BOOL;              (* relative move command (level) *)
    xMoveAbs    : BOOL;              (* absolute move command (level) *)
    xStartCycle : BOOL;              (* start auto fwd/back cycle (rising edge) *)

    rRelDist    : LREAL := 100.0;    (* relative move distance [mm] *)
    rTargetPos  : LREAL := 0.0;      (* absolute target position [mm] *)

    (* ================= Motion parameters ================= *)
    rJogVel     : LREAL := 10.0;     (* jog velocity [mm/s] *)
    rVel        : LREAL := 30.0;     (* positioning velocity [mm/s] *)
    rAcc        : LREAL := 200.0;    (* acceleration [mm/s2] *)
    rDec        : LREAL := 200.0;    (* deceleration [mm/s2] *)
    rStroke     : LREAL := 100.0;    (* auto cycle stroke (one way) [mm] *)
    tDwell      : TIME  := T#1S;     (* dwell time at cycle ends *)

    (* ================= Status ================= *)
    xPowered    : BOOL;              (* MC_Power.Status : servo enabled *)
    xAxisReady  : BOOL;              (* axis in StandStill -> motion allowed *)
    xBusy       : BOOL;              (* any motion active *)
    xDisabled   : BOOL;              (* axis state = Disabled *)
    xStandStill : BOOL;              (* axis state = StandStill *)
    xStopping   : BOOL;              (* axis state = Stopping *)
    xErrorStop  : BOOL;              (* axis state = ErrorStop *)
    xAxisError  : BOOL;              (* axis reports an error *)
    iAxisErrorID: DWORD;             (* axis error code *)
    rActPos     : LREAL;             (* actual position [mm] *)
    iState      : INT;               (* auto cycle step number *)
END_VAR
